title: Painting Contractor in Micanopy, FL | Pre-War Homes
description: Painting contractor in Micanopy, FL for pre-war homes, antique shops, and oak-shaded streets. Careful prep, own crews, licensed and insured, free estimates.
heroIntro: Pre-war houses, antique storefronts, and live oaks arching over every street: no other inland settlement in Florida has been around as long as Micanopy. Buildings like these call for slow, deliberate prep and a good eye for period color, and that is how we paint them.

sections.h2: Micanopy painters from just up the road in Newberry
body: We are a Newberry-based, locally owned, licensed, bonded, and fully insured painting contractor serving Micanopy, FL, with over 15 years spent painting in this part of the state. Nobody from outside the company works on your building, and the lead who quotes your Micanopy house is also the person supervising it day to day.

Micanopy asks for a different pace than a new subdivision. The town's pre-war houses and antique shops have been painted many times over many decades, and a fast spray-and-go approach does them no favors. What they need is patient scraping, honest carpentry repair, flexible caulking, and colors that respect the building.

sections.h2: Micanopy's buildings: pre-war homes and old storefronts
body: In the Historic District, most of our work is on older wood-sided homes with porches, tall windows, and plenty of trim. Layers of old paint have often built up on sills, railings, and window casings, and the bottom edges of siding and door frames are where rot shows up first. Out toward Tuscawilla Preserve and along the McIntosh corridor, the houses vary more in age and style, so the crew lead sizes up each one on its own terms rather than assuming a historic-district approach.

In the downtown blocks, the antique dealers and little commercial blocks bring their own list: storefront trim, sign bands, doors, and masonry, all of which want gentle cleaning and a finish that looks its age gracefully. For color ideas rooted in the region, browse our piece on period paint palettes from Gainesville's historic homes.

The oaks that make Micanopy so pretty are also the biggest variable in how long a paint job holds up. Under that canopy, siding and roofs can stay wet for a day or more after rain, and green growth takes hold on north and east walls, porch ceilings, and any surface beneath a big limb. Gutters fill with leaves and spill over onto the fascia. Summer piles on months of muggy air and storms most afternoons.

So on a Micanopy job, moisture gets handled before anything else. Mildew is killed rather than rinsed, any doubtful board is checked with a meter, punky wood is cut out and replaced, and the finished walls receive a pair of full 100% acrylic coats, or a penetrating stain on wood meant to keep its natural grain.

sections.h2: What working with us in Micanopy looks like
body: First comes a site visit, which we can usually set up within 48 hours of your call. The crew lead tapes off measurements, photographs the old paint and any damage, and meters suspect wood, then follows up with a written, itemized estimate generally one business day later. On that paper you will find what is covered and what is not, the prep plan, primer and finish products, coat counts, and dates; no extra line can appear without your signature.

Expect crews on site one to three weeks after you say yes. On a century-old house, the scraping and carpentry days before painting can take up much of the schedule. Interior jobs let you stay home, outside jobs land best between October and May, and nothing is closed out until you have walked it and signed. Our written warranty on exterior workmanship lasts up to 10 years, and the leftover colors stay with you, labelled.

From Micanopy our crews regularly head north to Gainesville, west to Archer, and east to Hawthorne. Over the Marion County line to the south, Ocala and its neighbors are on our route too. Every town we cover appears on the service areas page.

faqs.q: Do you paint older homes in Micanopy's Historic District?
faqs.a: Yes. Pre-war homes are a large part of our Micanopy work. Our schedules for these houses build in additional days for scraping, wood repair, and caulk, and your quote spells out each prep task.

faqs.q: How soon can you look at my Micanopy property?
faqs.a: Usually inside 48 hours of your call, and you should have the written price about a business day after the crew lead's visit.

faqs.q: Can you paint my shop without closing during business hours?
faqs.a: Yes. For Micanopy shops we can work evenings, weekends, or whatever hours keep your doors open, and we will send a certificate of insurance before the crew arrives.
Yes. Both Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore make eco-conscious, low-odor lines we use regularly, and whichever we choose for your house is written into the quote.
